m.rules_text.rationale: raw_data is empty and the label is only Kalshi rules_primary/settlement wording; PLAYER_BOX (nba.player_games) matched incidentally and is not needed. Only mkt.kalshi_rules (series metadata/rules text, STATIC) is required; note rules text of settled/old series may be truncated so wording versions are not fully recoverable.

m.lifecycle.rationale: Open/close/halt/postponement events are Kalshi market lifecycle plus schedule postponements; mapping to injury vintages, player box, team box and trades news is spurious (label has no availability/news content). Needs mkt.kalshi_rules/prices metadata and nba.schedule_arena for postponements; timestamps are native so PIT is not unavailable.

nba.stat_corrections.rationale: Needs box scores at game end versus 24-48h later (catalog measurement); nba.player_games is a single as-played archive without revision vintages and VENUE geo coordinates are not relevant. Requires prospective repeated box-score snapshots (new dataset nba.boxscore_vintages).

nba.off_rtg.rationale: Opponent-adjusted lineup-adjusted offensive rating is own-computed from nba.lineup_stints, pbp and box scores; RATINGS_EXT (nba.advanced_ratings, FINAL_ONLY) and RULES are spurious, which is what produces the leaky PIT verdict. Own computation from event-time data is PIT-safe (2024-26 lineup history only).

nba.lineup_adj_rating.rationale: Raw needs player impact estimates as of date and expected minute allocation for tonight; neither is in player_games/injury vintages. It is derived from nba.player_impact and nba.minutes (and active list from injury vintages, 2025-26 only), so cannot be DATA_IN_HAND.

nba.rest_travel.rationale: WEATHER_OBS is spurious: it matched 'altitude' but altitude, venue coordinates and time zone come from env.venue_geo; no weather is in raw_data (schedule dates/venues, rest flags). Needs schedule + venue only.

nba.travel_altitude.rationale: WEATHER_OBS (env.weather_observed, blocked host) and EVENT/pbp are spurious: travel distance, time zones and altitude come from env.venue_geo plus the schedule; no observed weather or play-level data is needed.

nba.standings_motivation.rationale: Raw says simulated seed distribution and clinch/elimination status plus remaining schedule: derived from nba.standings_sim, and the future schedule (nba.schedule_arena) is needed; not obtainable from final team_games alone.

nba.referee_crew.rationale: Needs referee assignments with announcement time; NEWS mapped to nba.transactions_draft (trades/draft) is the wrong dataset (matched 'announcement'). Right dataset is nba.referees (FREE_UNPROBED, assignments posted game day, history not in archives): PIT is coarse (daily posting), historical per-game crews must be scraped.

nba.playoff_whistle_regime.rationale: Referee assignments per playoff game with announcement time are required; NEWS->nba.transactions_draft is a spurious dataset. Needs nba.referees (unprobed, announced game day) plus team PF/FTA from box scores.

nba.three_pt_luck.rationale: Raw needs shot-level openness (closest-defender distance) which is tracking data (nba.tracking, NO_FREE_SOURCE); shots_xy/pbp give only location, not defender distance, so COMPUTED_PROXY hides a missing tracking field.

nba.garbage.rationale: Label/measurement: blowout probability as a function of the CLOSING SPREAD (a sportsbook line), i.e. market-derived. DRAFT (transactions_draft) is spurious. The market-free version is nba.rating_blowout_minutes_curve.

nba.starters_pit.rationale: Confirmed starters with timestamps (announced ~30 min pre-tip) are not in nba.lineup_stints (as-played) nor the injury report (no starter field). Using as-played lineups pregame leaks; needs prospective capture of timestamped starters.

nba.touches.rationale: Touches, time of possession, ball-handling load are player-tracking quantities (nba.tracking, NO_FREE_SOURCE); play-by-play/box score/lineup stints contain no touch or possession-time fields.

nba.pot_ast.rationale: Potential assists, passes made and secondary assists are tracking-derived (pass-level data); box scores and pbp only record completed assists. Requires nba.tracking (no free source).

nba.reb_chances.rationale: Rebound chances and contested rebounds are tracking fields (nba.tracking). AWARDS (nba.awards_allstar) matched 'contest' incidentally and is spurious; ToS risk flag is for the unofficial dashboards.

nba.turnover_pressure.rationale: Label requires turnovers per touch and deflections: touches are tracking, deflections are hustle stats (nba.playtype_scheme, paid). Box/pbp turnovers alone cannot give those denominators.

nba.three_volume.rationale: Raw includes catch-and-shoot and pull-up splits (tracking/play-type shot classification) and opponent 3PA allowed; only player_games is mapped (COMPUTED_PARTIAL), missing nba.tracking for the C&S share named in the label.

nba.three_make_by_openness_prior.rationale: Catalog measurement base model uses public shotchartdetail ACTION_TYPE/SHOT_ZONE over 3 seasons (nba.shots_xy 2023-26); defender-distance tracking is an explicitly optional refinement, so BLOCKED_NO_FREE_SOURCE is too pessimistic for the base model. Openness bins stay unavailable.
nba.three_make_by_openness_prior.notes: defender-distance refinement needs nba.tracking and is not covered

nba.first_basket_share.rationale: DRAFT (nba.transactions_draft) matched incidentally ('first basket'/'draft'); first-FGM share and first-possession usage come from pbp + lineups + box scores which are PIT-safe.

nba.tip_first_shot.rationale: SCHEME (nba.playtype_scheme, paid) is spurious: tip winner and first shot come from pbp jump-ball and first-event records; draft status BLOCKED_PAID_ONLY is too pessimistic.

nba.first_shot_type_make_prob.rationale: Raw is shot location, shooter and game time per first attempt plus opponent zone allowed rates: all in nba.shots_xy/pbp. SCHEME (paid play types) matched 'shot type' incidentally.

nba.player_xpts_per_shot.rationale: Raw is shotchartdetail fields (LOC_X, LOC_Y, zone, shot type, distance, made flag) = nba.shots_xy; SCHEME (paid) is spurious. Action-type labels may need pbp descriptions.

nba.team_assisted_fgm_expectation.rationale: Raw is team-game FGA/FGM/assisted FGM and possessions (box + pbp assist credit); 'opponent scheme adjustments' is a modelling step, so SCHEME (paid play types) is spurious.

nba.assisted_three_passer_map.rationale: Raw is play-by-play shooter/assister/made flag for threes, passer availability and games missed; SCHEME (paid) is spurious, and AVAIL (injury vintages) is needed only for the availability probabilities.

nba.onoff.rationale: On/off and lineup efficiency are reproducible from own nba.lineup_stints (registry note on nba.on_off_lineup_external); RATINGS_EXT (final-only advanced ratings) is spurious and creates the leaky verdict.

nba.standings_sim.rationale: Simulation of the remaining schedule from team ratings, injuries and tiebreakers (catalog measurement): derived from nba.ratings, nba.tiebreak_ledger, nba.injury_risk_season, nba.sos_remaining; needs future schedule (schedule_arena). VENUE, EVENT, PLAYER_BOX are spurious.

nba.title_path.rationale: Raw uses own-model team ratings and a bracket simulation: derived input; also needs seeds/bracket from the (future) schedule.

nba.series_model.rationale: Raw reads own team ratings and injury status: derived from nba.ratings and nba.injuries_pit; injury vintage history is only 2025-26.

nba.sos_remaining.rationale: Remaining schedule strength needs the future schedule (nba.schedule_arena; team_games holds results only) and opponent ratings (nba.ratings); AVAIL is not needed.

nba.all_star_process.rationale: Raw requires fan-vote leaderboard snapshots with timestamps; nba.awards_allstar holds final results (STATIC) so intermediate vote vintages must be captured (xx.news_timestamped); PIT_SAFE is unjustified.

nba.eligibility_minutes_ledger.rationale: Raw includes remaining schedule (future games; nba.schedule_arena) in addition to played minutes; team_games has results only. Injury status history is 2025-26 only.

nba.award_role_filters.rationale: Raw needs clutch splits (last 5 min, margin within 5) = play-by-play with on-court players, and a rookie registry (draft class/experience); neither mapped (EVENT/LINEUP/DRAFT missing) while AVAIL is spurious.

nba.expectation_overperformance.rationale: Preseason expectation (own, non-market) is a derived rating prior built from prior-season minutes/ratings: depends on nba.preseason_roster_aging_prior; remaining schedule needs nba.schedule_arena.

nba.monthly_window_schedule.rationale: Raw requires the schedule (games in window, future) plus past monthly award winners (nba.awards_allstar); schedule dataset is missing from the draft needs.

nba.minutes_scenario_mixture.rationale: Raw uses an own-model spread (derived from nba.ratings) and pbp substitutions; not purely archive data.

nba.own_game_environment.rationale: Own-model team points/possessions from team logs and lineup ratings: derived from nba.off_rtg, nba.def_rtg, nba.pace.

nba.starting_five_continuity.rationale: Raw is the game-level starting five (this and last season); the mapped dataset is only the injury report which has no starter field, while the started flag is in nba.player_games. Wrong dataset; history = 3 seasons.

nba.nonadditive_absence_curve.rationale: Raw needs player impact values (and margin residuals): derived from nba.player_impact, whose public vintages are final-only; DATA_IN_HAND ignores that.

nba.replacement_level_minutes_absorption.rationale: Raw needs player impact values alongside minutes/lineups; derived from nba.player_impact.

nba.roster_overlap_weighted_rating.rationale: Raw needs opponent-adjusted team ratings and tonight's projected minutes shares: derived from nba.ratings and nba.minutes.

nba.margin_heteroscedasticity.rationale: Walk-forward own-model mean margin and possessions: derived from nba.ratings and nba.pace.

nba.series_game_conditional_state.rationale: Raw needs own-model expected margin per game and injury status: derived from nba.series_model/nba.ratings.

nba.reg_tie_pmf_model.rationale: Raw requires regulation/final scores with period counts for 15 seasons; nba.team_games covers 2023-10 to 2026-11 (3 seasons) and pbp 2024+. Needs a long team-game history (new dataset). Also own-model margin/sd: derived. RULES kept for OT rule.

nba.last_possession_tie_attempt_rate.rationale: Needs a coach tenure table (coaching/staff history) which no mapped dataset provides; pbp (2024+) alone cannot supply it.

nba.game_pace_composition.rationale: Raw names play-type frequencies (transition vs half-court), a play-type field from nba.playtype_scheme (paid); RULES matched incidentally.

nba.joint_pace_interaction.rationale: Raw names play-type frequencies and transition vs half-court pace: nba.playtype_scheme (paid) field; pbp-based possession start types are only a proxy.

nba.series_length_distribution.rationale: Series length from per-game win probabilities is derived from nba.series_model/nba.ratings (own team ratings, injury status).

nba.final_margin_pmf_empirical.rationale: Raw is final scores of 15 seasons with walk-forward own-model mu/sigma: nba.team_games has 3 seasons, so history is insufficient; derived from nba.ratings and nba.margin_heteroscedasticity.

nba.margin_decay_after_pull.rationale: Raw needs coach per team-game; no mapped dataset holds coaching history.

nba.late_threshold_assist_rebound_giftin.rationale: Raw needs a coach tenure table (coaching history), absent from the mapped datasets.

nba.team_glass_strategy.rationale: Raw needs coach tenure (coaching history) and possession start type; only pbp/team box are mapped.

nba.second_half_adjustment_effect.rationale: Needs coach identity by game (coaching history); RATINGS_EXT (final-only advanced ratings) matched 'net rating' incidentally and causes the leaky verdict - period net rating is own-computed from pbp.

nba.second_unit_net_rating_gap.rationale: Impact rank is an own-computed upstream (nba.player_impact); RATINGS_EXT final-only dataset is not required, so the leaky verdict is overstated.

nba.asg_roster_strength_composite.rationale: Needs player impact per 100 and minutes plan from rotation input: derived from nba.player_impact and nba.rotation.

nba.governance_approval_pipeline.rationale: Raw is a deal timeline with dates and league approval thresholds; mapped to nba.team_games results (wrong dataset) and DATA_IN_HAND. Needs timestamped news plus rules text.

nba.qualifying_stage_requirement.rationale: 'Contract wording' means the Kalshi contract rules_primary/rules_secondary (raw_data), not player contracts; CONTRACTS->transactions_draft is spurious. Needs mkt.kalshi_rules only.

nba.rule_change_pipeline.rationale: Raw is rule proposals with stage and public date, Board of Governors calendar and vote outcomes: needs timestamped announcements, not only static rules; PLAYER_BOX spurious.

nba.game_factor_loadings.rationale: Raw includes own-model pregame expectations: derived from nba.own_model_team_totals and nba.minutes.

nba.own_model_team_totals.rationale: Own-model expected team points/total needs lineup availability and team ratings: derived from nba.off_rtg, nba.def_rtg, nba.pace, nba.lineup_adj_rating (injury history only 2025-26).

nba.heavy_minutes_tail_prob.rationale: Raw uses an own-model margin (derived from nba.ratings) and minutes.

nba.within_game_make_dispersion.rationale: Raw states 5 seasons of player-game attempts/makes by type; nba.player_games covers 3 seasons.

nba.ft_skill_posterior.rationale: Needs career FT/3P history and college FT% for rookies; nba.player_games covers only 2023-26 and no college data is mapped.

nba.dd_center_swap_share.rationale: Raw needs projected rotation: derived from nba.rotation / nba.minutes.

nba.rating_blowout_minutes_curve.rationale: Raw says ratings-based, 5 seasons of team-game margins; team_games has 3 seasons and pbp 2 (lineup stints 2024+). Derived from nba.ratings.

nba.usage_allocation_model.rationale: Needs tonight's projected units and minutes: derived from nba.minutes and nba.rotation.

nba.period_margin_pmf.rationale: Uses walk-forward rating-based expectations: derived from nba.ratings.

nba.first_passage_race_table.rationale: Raw takes first-stint rating from the opening-stint input: derived from nba.opening_stint_unit_rating.

nba.leader_share_by_usage_rank.rationale: Walk-forward pregame expected points: derived from nba.usage and nba.minutes.

nba.rating_update_gain.rationale: Raw is 15 seasons of team-game margins/possessions/rosters (nba.team_games has 3) and a preseason prior: derived from nba.preseason_roster_aging_prior; EVENT/pbp not needed.

nba.tiebreak_ledger.rationale: Raw is game results by team pair, division/conference ids and tiebreak rules; CONTRACTS (cap/contract keyword) is spurious and drives the PIT_UNAVAILABLE verdict.

nba.division_race_tiebreak_state.rationale: Catalog label: view of nba.tiebreak_ledger inside nba.standings_sim; PLAYER_BOX/NEWS are spurious. Derived input.

nba.finals_viewership_drivers.rationale: Viewership/TV ratings and market sizes are not in any mapped dataset (new dataset nba.tv_viewership); WEATHER_FCST and DRAFT are spurious.

nba.longest_streak_max_and_tie_model.rationale: Raw requires 15 prior seasons of team results and the remaining schedule; team_games has 3 seasons, schedule from schedule_arena; derived simulation from nba.ratings.

nba.qualification_probability.rationale: Injury hazard per game is derived from nba.injury_risk_season; remaining schedule needed; CONTRACTS (Kalshi contract rules text) and EVENT are spurious.

nba.team_record_head_to_head_linkage.rationale: Needs remaining schedule head-to-head counts (schedule_arena) and team rating posterior draws: derived from nba.ratings.

nba.pick_ownership_ledger.rationale: WEATHER_OBS is spurious; ledger needs pick ownership/swap/protection (transactions) and trade timelines; TEAM_BOX spurious.

nba.play_in_path_model.rationale: Raw: team ratings and rest -> derived from nba.ratings; standings before Play-In need the schedule.

nba.playoff_home_games_distribution.rationale: Raw uses bracket simulation outputs and series length pmf: derived from nba.title_path and nba.series_length_distribution.

nba.cup_group_tiebreak_state.rationale: Cup remaining-games simulation uses team ratings and the Cup schedule: derived from nba.ratings; schedule needed.

nba.rim_contest_volume_on_court.rationale: Raw is a defense dashboard of DFGA at rim and contests (tracking); AWARDS ('contest') is spurious; pbp cannot give contests.

nba.stocks_dependence_by_archetype.rationale: Raw is player-game steals, blocks, minutes (3 seasons); DRAFT is spurious (archetype labels are derived).

nba.combo_component_marginals.rationale: CONTRACTS (->transactions_draft) matched 'contracts' for Kalshi PRA/PR/PA contracts, not player contracts; needs only box/pbp (+ Kalshi rules).

nba.sl_format_scoring_baseline.rationale: Summer League results/period scores are not confirmed in nba.team_games (NBA regular-season/playoff archive); needs a Summer League game dataset.

nba.sl_mvp_award_model.rationale: Needs Summer League box scores, past SL MVP winners and bracket; nba.player_games is not confirmed to hold Summer League.

nba.sl_tournament_bracket_sim.rationale: Summer League schedule/results and standings are not in nba.team_games; needs Summer League dataset plus event rules.

nba.sl_first_half_share.rationale: Raw needs Summer League PBP substitutions and translated strength from nba.sl_talent_translation (derived); NBA pbp 2024+ is not confirmed to include Summer League.

nba.team_points_variance_by_style.rationale: Raw uses own-model expected points: derived from nba.own_model_team_totals.

nba.team_points_margin_curve.rationale: Raw is 5 seasons of team-game points with pregame expected margin from daily rating snapshots (derived from nba.ratings); team_games has 3 seasons.

nba.avg_rounding_and_games_state.rationale: Remaining team schedule (nba.schedule_arena) and Kalshi rounding rule text are needed; CONTRACTS (->transactions_draft) is spurious ('contract rounding rule' is Kalshi text).

nba.team_win_streak_hazard.rationale: Needs schedule with opponents and own-model game win probabilities: derived from nba.ratings; EVENT/pbp spurious.

nba.undefeated_start_survival.rationale: Needs schedule with dates and ratings: derived from nba.ratings; future schedule from nba.schedule_arena.

nba.cup_finals_pair_probability.rationale: Product of two conference bracket outcomes from ratings: derived from nba.cup_group_tiebreak_state and nba.ratings.

nba.hof_committee_vote_model.rationale: Career award/stat and coaching summaries span decades; nba.player_games covers only 2023-26 and no coaching history is mapped.

nba.series_ot_count_model.rationale: Raw uses own-model margin per game and series length: derived from nba.ot_prob_ratings_margin and nba.series_model.

nba.schedule_marquee_selection_model.rationale: Raw includes national-TV game counts, DMA rank and leak timestamps (timestamped news), not in team_games/awards; schedule data needed; PIT_SAFE unjustified.

nba.apology_statement_hazard.rationale: Raw is an incident/discipline log and dated player statements (news); mapped only to pbp and player box so DATA_IN_HAND is wrong.

nba.overseas_signing_hazard.rationale: Raw is unsigned-player lists by date and overseas signing dates (transactions); pbp/player box do not hold them.

nba.unsigned_player_signing_hazard.rationale: Raw is unsigned free-agent lists by date and signing/first-appearance dates (transactions); missing NEWS/CONTRACTS dataset, DATA_IN_HAND wrong.

nba.cross_league_title_combo.rationale: Joint of NBA and NHL title simulation outputs: derived.

nba.multi_game_ml_pack_model.rationale: Raw uses own-model leg probabilities and injury snapshots: derived from nba.ratings and nba.injuries_pit.

nba.series_stat_leader_model.rationale: Raw is playoff player-game box scores for 15 seasons; player_games covers 3. Derived from series model.

nba.team_bench_points_model.rationale: Raw needs confirmed starting lineups with timestamps (not in as-played lineup_stints/injury report) and substitution stints.

nba.league_first_to_threshold_race.rationale: Needs the regular-season schedule (future games) and availability vintages; team_games holds results only.

nba.league_extreme_game_event_rate.rationale: Raw needs 5+ seasons of game totals and 20 seasons of player steals/blocks; archive has 3. DRAFT is spurious.

nba.playoff_max_deficit_comeback_rate.rationale: Raw: play-by-play for 15 seasons; nba.pbp covers 2024-2026; also own-model pregame margin.

nba.playoff_round_event_counts.rationale: Raw: 20 seasons of playoff series results; own-model series win probabilities: derived.

nba.contest_shooting_skill_transfer.rationale: WEATHER_OBS is spurious ('conditions' = rack conditions); catch-and-shoot by defender distance needs tracking (kept); contest ball-by-ball results come from awards history.

nba.dunk_judge_score_model.rationale: Dunk-level judge scores and panel lists are not in team_games; TEAM_BOX is spurious. Needs a hand-coded Dunk Contest log.

nba.dunk_difficulty_make_model.rationale: Raw needs dunk-level tier tags, attempts, make/miss and judge scores; mapped to team_games results (wrong dataset). Requires manual coding.

nba.asg_minutes_rotation_plan.rationale: Raw includes coach press-conference statements (news) and All-Star minutes by year; static awards dataset cannot supply them.

nba.opening_night_starter_signals.rationale: Raw includes coach statement coding (news) and preseason starter flags; only lineup_stints mapped.

nba.asg_tournament_path_sim.rationale: Raw: pairwise expected margins from the roster-strength input: derived.

nba.asg_mvp_vote_model.rationale: Raw uses tournament path simulation output: derived.

nba.asg_mvp_fan_vote_share.rationale: Raw is fan-ballot vote totals (January returns) and reported vote splits; final results are not vote vintages; needs captured news.

nba.series_sum_stopping_simulator.rationale: Raw uses own-model possessions/points per possession: derived.

nba.playoff_round_scoring_shift.rationale: Raw: team game logs 2004-present; nba.team_games 3 seasons, pbp not needed.

nba.series_game_number_drift.rationale: Raw uses pre-game own-model totals: derived.

nba.clinch_elimination_margin_profile.rationale: Raw: playoff pbp 2004+ with pregame ratings gap; pbp covers 2024+; derived.

nba.series_banked_points_state.rationale: DRAFT is spurious; needs final team points per series game and the next scheduled game/venue (schedule).

nba.second_half_reg_ot_joint_margin.rationale: Joint output from one simulated game: derived.

nba.ot_prob_ratings_margin.rationale: Overtime probability from ratings-implied regulation margin: derived from nba.ratings; RULES spurious.

nba.franchise_valuation_comps.rationale: VENUE (venue_geo) is spurious for sale/expansion price comps; needs finance valuations and sale news only.

registry_objections.objection: hist is 2024-2026 (about two seasons) yet many inputs require 5-15 seasons of play-by-play; shots_xy starts 2023 and lineup_stints 2024; any 3+ season pbp/lineup requirement should fail on history, not just on access status.
Covers 2025-10-21..2026-06-13 only (one season, 167k rows) but several raws ask for vintage history from 2021-22 or multi-season injury history; the dataset cannot satisfy those.
